ai_disclosure.title: AI Usage Disclosure
ai_disclosure.meta_description: EU AI Act Article 50(4) compliance. Legal name of natural person responsible for editorial oversight: Andrei Klemenchionok. Published under pseudonym «Comandante FolkUp».

section1.p1: Books of the FolkUp Library are signed with the pseudonym «Comandante FolkUp». Behind the pseudonym stands one living person: Andrei Klemenchionok, resident of Portugal, publisher and editor. The pseudonym is a Banksy-style pattern for non-commercial brand identity, not concealment of responsibility.

section2.p1: FolkUp uses AI assistants (Anthropic Claude and other models) as drafting and research tools in book production:
section2.item1: Literary analysis and structural work on manuscripts
section2.item2: Translation (Russian → English, German, European Portuguese) with subsequent native-speaker human editing
section2.item3: Fact-checking through OSINT research and cross-source verification
section2.p2: Every published book passes human gate-controls:
section2.gate1: Editorial gate — manuscript compilation, quality control ЩИТ v5.0
section2.gate2: Native-speaker review for non-Russian translations (Vier-Augen / Quatro Olhos / Four-Eyes principle)

section3.p1: This page fulfils the requirement to disclose the natural person responsible for editorial oversight of AI-assisted content per EU AI Act Article 50(4)(b). Responsible person: Andrei Klemenchionok, Russian citizen, resident of Portugal.
section3.p2: The pseudonym «Comandante FolkUp» is used on public surfaces (book pages, catalog, footer, metadata) — Banksy-style pattern for non-commercial brand identity. The pseudonym holds the series brand; this page provides legal disclosure per AI Act.
